'''''Basic Interrogations''''' was a publication authored by [[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]]. When [[Cryle Cavv]] was held prisoner and interrogated by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]], Cavv suggested the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] needed more time to read up on the information in the document.<ref name="TFO">{{JournalCite|15|Two for One}}</ref>
